title: Zesty Golden Slovakian Cauliflower Soup
description: A savory, creamy cauliflower soup infused with a bright yellow hue, spicy tadka, and ketofriendly ingredients, perfect for an energizing meal.

ingredients.name: tadka spice mix (cumin seeds, mustard seeds, dried chili flakes, asafoetida)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the tadka spice mix and sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in the diced onion, minced garlic, and grated carrot; cook until the onion becomes translucent (≈4 minutes).
Add the cauliflower florets, low‑sodium vegetable broth, and coconut milk; bring to a gentle boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until the cauliflower is tender.
Remove the pot from heat and use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth (or transfer to a blender in batches).
Return the soup to low heat, stir in the yellow food coloring and lemon juice, and season with salt and pepper.
Simmer for an additional 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and a drizzle of olive oil if desired.
